title: Payment
description: Complete the form for your quoted service and continue to PayPal to pay.

form.intro: Enter the amount quoted by your AET office. After you submit, PayPal opens in a new tab to complete the payment.
form.name: Your Name
form.serviceOther: Please specify if you choose other
form.amountHelp: Use the exact USD amount on your quote or invoice.
form.terms: I have read and agree to the Service Terms and Privacy Notice.
form.newTab: PayPal opens in a new tab

alternatives.intro: The legacy payment page also offers deposit, check, and Zelle transfer. Contact the office handling your service to confirm current instructions before sending money.

security.paragraph: This form collects service and contact details. Payment details are entered after you continue to PayPal.

shipping.intro: If your service includes physical delivery, use the current shared shipping rates below. Confirm the option with your office before adding any shipping charge to your payment.
